?

Isaiah 48:17b MSG
…”I am God, your God, who teaches you how to live right and well. I show you what to do, where to go.
?
Yesterday, we shared about not being stranded or reaching a dead end. The fact is that, only those without a “roadmap” miss their way or get stranded.
?
This year;
?God will show you where to go
?He will show you what to do even in critical conditions.
?He will teach you or show you what strategy to apply per time or season.
?He will teach you how to choose right and choose well.
?
Isaiah 30:21 MSG
urging you on whenever you wander left or right: “This is the right road. Walk down this road.”
?
This year, you will not be stranded or be led to a dead end. The Lord will order your steps??at all times in Jesus name
